scope: Independent streaming execution of the canonical calibration plan and exact C71TRC01 frame comparison; locally exercised on bounded data and statically audited against the full public geometry, without real checkpoint weights.

implementation.matrix_method: blocked binary64 BLAS under a checked absolute partial-sum bound below 2^53
implementation.rms_method: independent C11 batched exact RNE with 192-bit limb comparisons

checks.command: C71_CALIBRATION_BINARY=$PWD/rust/target/debug/examples/c71_calibration PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=$PWD/scripts .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_c71_calibration.py tests/test_c71_calibration_oracle.py tests/test_c71_calibration_oracle_driver.py tests/test_c71_calibration_trace.py

checks.note: LeakSanitizer is disabled because it cannot run under the sandbox ptrace environment; AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer completed.

diagnostic_failures: The first sanitizer harness used inconsistent hand-entered RMS coefficients and correctly returned a failure; the corrected coefficients came from the public recipe.
LeakSanitizer alone cannot run under the sandbox ptrace environment; the successful sanitizer command disables leak detection only.
